hunted_j16: On Day 3 Henrik Hunted took a post at R-F4 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He collects shell fuses, and the men liked him for it.
Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony spotted Henrik Hunted of the Concord repairing a parapet at the Drowned Farm. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
Officers came to inspect R-F4. Henrik Hunted polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.

Henrik Hunted had Jakub "Hollow" Hill of the Hegemony in the sights at the Hanging Bridge for a long second. Jakub "Hollow" Hill was lighting a pipe. Henrik Hunted let the match burn all the way down.
miguell.jacob: The new runner is Otto "Ash" Jacob, once a coal miner from Millbank. The corporal asked if a coal miner was any use in a trench. Otto "Ash" Jacob said he would find out.
Volunteer number 41. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Otto "Ash" Jacob's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
Otto "Ash" Jacob began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached R-F14 with the rations. Otto "Ash" Jacob ate while listening to the revised orders.
The reply to Otto "Ash" Jacob's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn.
Otto "Ash" Jacob and Wendel "Mole" Freddie made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A single shot from across the wire hit Otto "Ash" Jacob in the thigh at R-F14. He crawled the last yards on his elbows.
someonenamedmiguel: Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed walked into R-F19 on Day 3 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed (Concord) shouted a challenge across to Otto Elitecelebs (Hegemony) at Calvary Farm. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.

Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed fixed the strap on Gideon "Ghost" Marks's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut. A letter from home found Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed before the night shift. Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet clipped Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed's helmet at R-F19 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. A letter from home found Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed before the night shift. Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed folded it small and kept it close.
tom_ua_: In Belmonte, Anselm Tom was a railway porter. In S-F9, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a railway porter again.
Volunteer number 94. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Anselm Tom's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
The transfer made Anselm Tom a machine gunner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
Edmund Somosmagios and Anselm Tom compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Anselm Tom thought about a younger sister who sends drawings on sentry tonight, and the cold felt a little further away.

Anselm Tom cut Matthias Mihai's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. Verdel Ridge is lost. Anselm Tom heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Splinters from a shell rained down on S-F9. Anselm Tom took one in the shoulder and had it dug out right there on the fire step.
The wound Anselm Tom shrugged off has gone the wrong colour. He is not shrugging any more.
Anselm Tom drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
zgeorges11: Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges arrived on Day 3 as a replacement. The men in R-F18 had been fighting for 2 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world. Verdel Ridge is lost. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges fired at a movement across the wire at R-F18. The man went down: Gideon "Whistle" Vylet, grazed.

Benedikt Jakubwilkuu (Concord) and Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges (Hegemony) ended up in the same shell hole at the Chalk Pits. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone. A letter from home found Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges before the night shift. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges folded it small and kept it close.

A trench mortar bomb landed in the next section of trench. The blast caught Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges at R-F18 and the bearers came at a run. A letter from home found Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges before the night shift. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges folded it small and kept it close.
